issues.note: This is ordinary sung 1962 source trajectory. Low Mass and solemn minister tracks need their own event controllers and checks.
Do not conflate station at altar centre with a separate Missal/book position or Gospel-side direction; book-side is a separate model dimension.
Sung text has 280 unique cue entries; current reader cue validation previously expected 279. Do not silently drop source cue without source reconciliation.
Movement during long Schola texts cannot be inferred from user swiping in LIVE; preserve last independently observed station or show unknown.
C0250 must restore Epistle-side Missal station at Communion antiphon; staged explicitly as source-backed correction without changing the older frozen 49-record registry.
Gospel-side Missal from C0081 to C0250, while celebrant frequently stands at altar centre; do not replace priest-centre pictogram with Gospel-side priest pictogram during Preface.

missalPositionTransitions.trigger: Missal placed on Epistle side before Mass
Missal returned after ablutions, before Communion antiphon

supplementaryRitusPositionTransitions.reason: Following the ablutions the Missal is returned to the Epistle side and celebrant reads Communion antiphon before he returns to centre for Dominus vobiscum; source position registry had PRIEST_TRACK_ASYNC at C0249 but lacked the C0250 station return.

formActorExceptions.note: Source priest timeline needs independent observed transition; do not render priest reciting Epistle at missal merely because Epistle text is shown.
Priest could read or sing Epistle, or lector sings; must know participant.
The deacon proclaims Gospel; the priest does not stand at Gospel-side Missal to deliver deacon's text.
